'''Tarascii Explosives''' was an explosives producer that specialized in the manufacture of [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]]. A subsidiary of [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]], Tarascii was one of the few companies authorized to manufacture weapons with [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="ROE" />
